result.title: Is it RL or Data? A Controlled Comparison of GRPO and Rejection-Sampling Fine-Tuning
result.summary: Bauer et al. (2026) showed that in low-data reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, training GRPO on mixed-difficulty prompts gives up to 5x the sample efficiency of easy-only prompts. They did not test whether this benefit is specific to GRPO, or whether another post-training method given the same data would obtain it too. We test this on their procedural counting task with Qwen3-4B-Base and LoRA, comparing GRPO to rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT) on the same prompts, verifier and token cap. Six primary arms cross the two methods with three prompt sets (Easy, Mixed, and a Curated subset of prompts the base model sometimes solves, which makes GRPO's implicit filter explicit). We use three seeds per arm. Hypotheses and falsifiers were registered before training. To rule out a poorly tuned baseline, RFT receives a 27-run hyperparameter sweep, while GRPO uses Bauer et al.'s recipe unchanged. GRPO outperforms RFT at every prompt set: by 10.9 points on held-out test problems with curated prompts, and, in post hoc comparisons with matched rollout budgets, by 8.4 and 9.2 points on the easy and mixed prompts. On test the advantage survives the least favorable treatment of truncated completions; out of distribution, truncation prevents a conclusion. Curating prompts does not help RFT (-2.7 points). Mixed-difficulty data helps RFT (+3.7 points), while for GRPO the evidence is inconclusive. A secondary iterated-RFT arm, which resamples from the current policy, recovers 3.2 of the 10.9-point gap (about 30%). These are controlled measurements on one synthetic task family and one base model with three seeds per arm.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 Bauer 等人的程序化计数任务上，用 Qwen3-4B-Base 加 LoRA，对 GRPO 与拒绝采样微调（RFT）做受控对比：交叉两种方法、三种提示集，各三个随机种子，并预注册假设与否证条件，检验混合难度数据的收益是否为 GRPO 独有。
AI.relevance_reason: 这是纯文本后训练的方法学对比工作，不涉及视觉或 latent 推理；但其「收益来自数据还是算法」的受控设计、匹配 rollout 预算的对照、以及迭代 RFT 从当前策略重采样的做法，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练、贡献分配与监督信号归因提供可核查的实验设计线索。
